title: eludite.solution.open input
description: Open a solution (File > Open > Project/Solution, Ctrl+Shift+O). Starts eludite-host if it is not running and loads the solution in it. Returns once the request is handed to the host; loading, the Workspace tree and diagnostics stream in afterwards (see eludite/solution/status in host-rpc.md). Opening a solution replaces the workspace: it closes the solution and folder that are open. Do not call it when the solution is already open (eludite.solution.tree and eludite.workspace.tree list what is open) or to debug a project: eludite.debug.start takes a project file's path, whether or not the open solution contains it. The UI shows a file dialog first and passes the chosen path.

path.description: Absolute path of a .sln, .slnx, .csproj, .vbproj or .fsproj file.
